attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: filtered_api_notification
steps:
  - id: fetch_records
    op: api_call
    params:
      method: GET
      endpoint: /api/records/latest
    output: raw_records

  - id: filter_records
    op: filter
    params:
      input: "{{ fetch_records.raw_records }}"
      condition: "record.is_relevant == true"
    output: relevant_records

  - id: send_notification
    op: notify
    params:
      input: "{{ filter_records.relevant_records }}"
      channel: default
      subject: "New Relevant Records Detected"
      body: "There are {{ filter_records.relevant_records | length }} new relevant records: {{ filter_records.relevant_records }}"
